After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.
But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
translations.bsb: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
translations.kjv: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
translations.asv: Yea, see thou thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel. Psalm 129 A Song of Ascents.
